userTheme: SALAH dark theme by default; optional paper theme

textIntegrity.note: Page metadata derived from the existing verified page fields. All verse strings, including original source bismillah prefixes, are rendered unchanged. No generated Quran text, translation or transliteration is used in the page content.

layout: Reflowable Arabic text grouped by the existing 604-page division; not a reproduction of printed line breaks.
navigation: horizontal swipe; ignore vertical scroll and multitouch

verification.offline: Uses existing verified surah cache. No new text network source.
